fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects DNS server discovery via LDAP query requests from uncommon applications
fields.name: DNS Server Discovery Via LDAP Query
fields.query: event.category="dns" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (event.dns.request contains "_ldap." and (not ((src.process.image.path contains ":\\Program Files\\" or src.process.image.path contains ":\\Program Files (x86)\\" or src.process.image.path contains ":\\Windows\\") or (src.process.image.path contains ":\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Platform\\" and src.process.image.path contains "\\MsMpEng.exe") or src.process.image.path="<unknown process>" or not (src.process.image.path matches "\.*"))) and (not (src.process.image.path contains "C:\\WindowsAzure\\GuestAgent" or (src.process.image.path contains "\\chrome.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\firefox.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\opera.exe")))))
